content.short: An online CNFT Trading card game based on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
ShadowRealms is an online trading card game based on the Cardano Blockchain. Players can battle it out for victory and glory! This CNFT trading card game is a game where you not only play with the cards.. But also OWN them. Unlike traditional online card games where if there server were to go down, you would lose everything.. ShadowRealms has taken a different approach, thanks to the utility of NFT's, we are able to bring trading card games to a whole new level.

Members will face off in a 1 on 1 match where cards will be strategically placed on the battle field to fight for the right to defend the Earth Realm. Those strong enough to succeed will face off an even greater enemy.. In the ShadowRealms.
